name: IDrive 360
summary: IDrive 360 is priced by device count, from $14.95 a month for 5 devices, with a 10 TB quota per device. Backups follow a schedule, a daily immutable snapshot allows restore to a chosen date, and a private encryption key that IDrive does not store can be set during installation.

facts.text: A daily snapshot is captured for the entire backed-up data of a computer, snapshots are immutable, and restore by date applies only to accounts created or devices added on or after March 5, 2024.
Up to 30 versions of each file are stored, and only the latest version counts toward the storage quota.
IDrive says it does not store the private encryption key, so data cannot be retrieved without it.
Scheduling options include a start time, daily or weekday runs, an optional cut-off time, and starting a missed scheduled backup when the computer is turned on.
The 25% first-year discount applies to yearly plans, and later years are billed at the normal yearly rate.

plans.name: 5 devices
plans.notes: $112.12 for the first year of a yearly plan with the 25% discount. 10 TB quota per device. Larger device counts are listed on the pricing page.

hiddenCosts: Devices beyond the plan limit cost $2.95 per device per month.
Storage above 10 TB per device costs $6 per TB per month.
Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace backup are add-ons at $20 per seat per year.

contract.dataExport: Restores are done per computer from the Restore tab, to the same or a different target machine.
